about_short_description.short_description: 365 Adventures is a tourism company that provides travel experiences throughout Arabia.

product.name: Desert Safari
product.description: A tour that includes dune bashing and a visit to the Inland Sea, offering a blend of adventure and scenic beauty.

product.name: Kayaking
product.description: Guided kayaking tours in various locations, including mangrove forests and around iconic landmarks.

product.name: Cultural Tours
product.description: Guided visits to cultural and historical sites, providing insights into the heritage and traditions of the region.

product.name: Adventure Sports
product.description: Activities such as paddleboarding, kiteboarding, and wakeboarding, catering to thrill-seekers.

product.name: Camping
product.description: Offers both traditional and luxurious camping experiences in the desert, including overnight stays.

product.name: City Tours
product.description: Guided tours of major cities, showcasing landmarks, museums, and architectural marvels.
